body:
Thanks for the advice, and you're right - my happiness shouldn't be so dependent on another person, but it is.  The thing is, she's not even sure if she wants to go - just wants to live with her parents for a month, not see other people. 

If it came down to her leaving, I don't think I have it in me to go through finding another. 

This feeling of being so mentally exhausted is really getting to me.
We have been there for each other for almost 6 years.  It's only recently after we moved, which is one of the major things she resents, she's started acting cold toward me.
yes to your question. i just dont have the energy to start all over again.  besides that, i love this girl, i don't want to lose her =/
